en.text: Did the money we sent help?
Did the money that we sent help?

original: 本送ったの？

en.text: Did you send the book?

original: 私が送った荷物は届いた？

en.text: Did you get the package I sent you?

original: 私が送ったメール、届いた？

en.text: Did you receive the email I sent you?

original: 電報を送りたいんですが。

en.text: I want to send a telegram.

original: トムに何通手紙を送ったの？

en.text: How many letters did you send to Tom?

original: 私が送ったメッセージ、全部消して。

en.text: Delete all the messages I sent you.
Delete all the messages I sent.

original: 郵便局まで送るよ。

en.text: I'll drive you to the post office.

original: 荷物を送るのに、郵便局に行ってた。

en.text: I went to the post office to send a package.

original: 写真、送って。

en.text: Send a photo.

original: 平凡な毎日を送っている。

en.text: I live an ordinary life.

original: トムは母の日に母親に花束を送った。

en.text: Tom sent his mother some flowers on Mother's Day.
